user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicit instruction walkthroughs using authored fixtures. All product-behavior cases are simulated; not independent agent execution, human research, or real app use. Actual API reads and page audits are recorded separately.

scenarios.request: Assess a paid tier for a free export tool. Fixture usage-log records three volunteers completing weekly exports on three dated sessions; no paid offer exists.
scenarios.expected: Evidence of repeat use survives; payment and audience generality remain unverified.
scenarios.observed: Before: WHO rule rejected nonpaying volunteers despite the usage-log. After: verified-within-fixture repeated exports for the named three; broad WHO assumed; willingness to pay unknown. NARROW to observed users for research, not launch; next action is an offer test, not a claim of demand. No actual volunteer data collected.

scenarios.request: Same claim, but there is no log and the author only predicts that volunteers would love it.
scenarios.observed: WHO and repeat use unknown/assumed; ask for a recent concrete instance or observe task completion. A proposed offer is a future test, not payment evidence.

scenarios.request: A buyer paid once, but there is no use log.
scenarios.expected: Avoid converting purchase to retention or completed use.
scenarios.observed: Payment verified only if its receipt is supplied; repeated use and target task completion remain unknown. No claim that one buyer validates the market.

similar_skills.learned: Recruit for actual behavior and domain knowledge; tie the study to a decision.
similar_skills.reason: Use observed behavior to establish the claimed user group; do not require payment for free products or import fixed sample-size/speed claims.

similar_skills.learned: Continuing to use a prototype and committing time can matter alongside payment; seek disconfirming observations.
similar_skills.reason: Keep use evidence distinct from willingness to pay; real-human counterexamples improve a simulation bridge. Reject universal interview-count thresholds.

validation.observed: Executed page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Changed: separate observed use from willingness to pay; add free-product input/output and missing-evidence recovery. Existing products.json title/description/topics remain accurate and are retained.
